summary: Added the critical S3MirrorStale rule to the prd Prometheus values. It fires when the s3-mirror CronJob's last success, or its creation time before any success, is over 52 h old; the threshold covers the 2 h run bound and the Europe/Amsterdam DST change. tests/test_prometheus_s3_mirror_alert.py walks both edges against the storage chart's values, a one-off promtool 3.14.0 test run checked the PromQL, and kc project test is green. Committed on HelmCharts phase/022-P3 (32d40de).
